name: Feast Of Tabernacles The
overview: The Feast of Tabernacles, as detailed in Numbers 29, is a divinely ordained seven-day celebration marked by specific burnt offerings and sacrifices, including thirteen young bullocks, rams, lambs, and a kid goat, all without blemish. This feast, beginning on the fifteenth day of the seventh month, involves a structured pattern of offerings each day, accompanied by meat and drink offerings in precise quantities. It commemorates Israel's sojourn in the wilderness and is observed with holy convocations, rejoicing, and the dwelling in booths, emphasizing both remembrance and worship in a communal setting.
